## How to test it

## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt` and `topcoat fmt` leave no changes
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` pass
- [ ] New or changed text is in both `en.ftl` and `de.ftl`
- [ ] Model changes include a migration in `toasty/`
- [ ] Screenshots are attached for visible changes
